author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Hugh Jackman’s Bondi Beach penthouse, purchased for $5.9 million in 2015, is now estimated to be worth up to $15.5 million. The actor is reportedly staying at the luxury Australian property with girlfriend Sutton Foster, who recently visited Sydney for the first time. The couple were spotted exploring Bondi Beach and enjoying its famous coastal walk.
title: Hugh Jackman’s $5.9M Bondi penthouse now worth $15.5M

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: An employee from Agartala resigned after nine months and faced a demand for training costs. The company claimed he owed Rs 90,000 despite completing his notice period. Delays in salary and exit documents complicated the situation further for him. Seeking help from the labour office, he eventually received his due documents after a six-week process. His experience highlights the importance of understanding employment agreements and keeping detailed employment records.

title: Nikki Haley’s son backs her decision to skip 2028 race after Republican midterm losses

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Chirag Paswan took a strong stance against Rahul Gandhi, accusing him of using unverified phone-tapping claims to disrupt parliamentary proceedings. He highlighted Gandhi's consistent irresponsibility and the ineffective nature of his previous allegations, including issues of voter deletions. Paswan pointed out the lack of public support for Gandhi's rallies, emphasizing that such tactics have failed to gain traction.
title: Chirag Paswan claims Rahul Gandhi raised phone-tapping charge to disrupt Parliament

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Nathan and Devan Dickey experienced a devastating loss when their belongings disappeared from their rented storage units at Posey Storage Solutions. Despite Tim Posey’s assurances about security, the court found him liable for fraudulent misrepresentation and gross negligence. Ultimately, the Dickeys were awarded over $57,000 in damages, emphasizing the critical need for transparency and honesty in the storage industry to protect customer trust.
title: Tennessee couple wins $57,200 after belongings vanish from storage units

author: KANCHAN YADAV
title: 'Will change Tata way': Noel warns Tata Sons listing may put profits ahead of philanthropy

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: India suffered a significant batting collapse in the fourth ODI against New Zealand, leading to serious concerns. Head coach Gautam Gambhir and former opener Aakash Chopra emphasized the need for greater responsibility from the batters. New Zealand's Matt Henry took six wickets, dismantling India's top order effectively. This loss was India's second-heaviest in ODI history, highlighting ongoing issues within the batting lineup.
title: 'Can't completely surrender': Ex-cricketer criticises India after embarrassing loss

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: In a bid to engage the youth, Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann has launched 'Punjab Da Crorepati,' a quiz competition for individuals aged 15 to 30. With a grand prize of Rs 1 crore, participants will navigate through 11 rounds, including two live events hosted in 23 districts. Notably, 10,000 contestants stand to win additional prizes, while runners-up will each receive Rs 10 lakh.
title: 'Punjab da crorepati': Mann govt's big Gen Z push; launches 11-round quiz challenge

author: VRITI JAIN
description: Six individuals were arrested in connection with the murder of Jinggi Bankira in Hadimara village. The dispute arose over a debt of Rs 500 owed by Reena Gope's deceased husband. Following an altercation, Bankira was attacked by the accused, leading to her death from severe injuries. Evidence collected during the investigation included blood-stained items linked to the crime.
title: Dragged, beaten with sticks, fists: J'khand woman killed over Rs 500 owed by dead man

title: Magnitude 4 earthquake strikes Assam's Kamrup district

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Ukraine is exploring NATO membership, which could involve giving up the Donbas region for security guarantees. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that US negotiators raised the issue during ongoing peace talks with Russia. Meanwhile, Ukraine is seeking additional military support and ammunition from European allies to enhance its defense capabilities against Russian aggression. Discussions include reinforcing air defense and energy infrastructure as winter approaches.
title: Ukraine's Nato bid back on table, but at what cost? Zelenskyy on US Donbas question

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Wasim Akram has expressed doubt regarding Pat Cummins' assertion of being unaware of the 2018 ball-tampering scandal. Akram states that a bowler with experience should be able to recognise the distinctive scratches made by sandpaper. Conversely, Cummins has firmly dismissed Usman Khawaja's allegations that the entire Australian squad was complicit.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Reflecting on his investing journey, Raza Adil Rizvi discusses his choice to purchase a flat instead of pursuing alternative investments. After ten years of saving, he acquired a flat for ₹2.25 crore, ensuring his family's safety and comfort. Acknowledging the wisdom in his wife's advice to focus on homeownership, Rizvi highlights the mixed social media responses to his decision.
title: Man spends 10 years of savings on Rs 2.25 crore flat; wife's words go viral

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: The Leonid meteor shower will peak on November 17-18, producing around 10 to 15 meteors an hour under ideal viewing conditions. The annual shower is caused by debris from comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle. Its history includes the extraordinary 1833 Great Meteor Storm, when hundreds of thousands of shooting stars lit up the sky over eastern North America.
title: Up to 15 meteors an hour: Leonid shower peaks November 17-18

author: TATHAGATA BHATTACHARJEE
description: On Friday night, a class nine student attacked his mother, injuring her seriously with a knife. The victim, Chandrani Kalita, is currently hospitalized in the Intensive Care Unit. Following the attack, the student jumped from a building, which resulted in his death. Police are investigating the incident but have not provided further details at this time. Updates will be shared as more information about the case becomes available.
title: Assam Class 9 student stabs mother with knife, writes about attack before jumping to death

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: A blind 67-year-old Nigerian woman named Comfort is on the brink of deportation after living in the UK for 26 years. Despite never setting foot in India, her plea for permanent residency was denied, suggesting she could receive care in either Nigeria or India. This case exposes flaws in the immigration process as the Home Office suggests new corrective measures, all while many migrants now endure extended delays.
title: 26 years in UK, then letter sending Nigerian woman to India: Home office bizarre mix-up

author: AASHISH VASHISTHA
title: US flight chaos: Trump official seeks $50 billion for air traffic control

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a landmark ruling, a Washington court awarded a woman $328,715.53 from her husband's retirement funds. She raised concerns over tax consequences and financial liquidity, but the court upheld the arrangement, taking into account their financial situation and the duration of their marriage. Moreover, her requests for spousal support and legal fees were dismissed, a decision confirmed by the appellate court which maintained the original settlement.
title: Washington wife awarded $328,715 from ex-husband's 401(k), not cash

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: PM Modi's convoy helicopter developed technical snag, remains stranded in Mysuru

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A couple encountered a frightening situation when two men allegedly chased their car on Diwali night. The couple managed to reach their residential society’s entrance, where security personnel intervened. The other vehicle's occupants remained at the society gate for an extended period. Dashcam footage from the car and CCTV footage was shared on social media. Police have acknowledged the situation and initiated an investigation into the incident.
title: 'What my 40% tax gets': Gurgaon man shares dashcam footage of being chased on Diwali

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Rakesh Asthana, the former CBI special director, rebutted Sonia Gandhi's memoir regarding the Godhra train fire's cause. He emphasized that investigations confirmed the fire was deliberately set, supported by court verdicts. The Nanavati Commission and the Supreme Court-appointed SIT reinforced the findings of the Gujarat Police investigation. During the 2002 incident, 59 people died when a train was set on fire.
title: Godhra train fire was deliberate, Sonia Gandhi's memoir claim is wrong: Ex-CBI officer

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The B-21 Raider conducted its first conventional weapon-release test at Edwards Air Force Base. This achievement is pivotal for the US Air Force's next-generation stealth bomber program. The design focuses on integrating new weapons and validating operational capabilities for long-range strikes. The Air Force aims to acquire at least 100 B-21 aircraft to replace older bombers. These developments indicate the commitment to enhancing national defense strategies and capabilities.
title: US B-21 stealth bomber drops first conventional weapon in landmark test

author: SOROR SHAIZA
description: Portugal are preparing an emotional farewell to Cristiano Ronaldo following his international retirement after 23 years and 146 goals. Every squad member will reportedly wear his iconic No. 7 shirt before facing Denmark, while the match will pause in the seventh minute for supporters to applaud. The tributes will honour the country's most decorated footballer and his historic contribution to Portuguese football.
title: Portugal plan special Ronaldo tribute: Entire squad to wear No. 7 shirts

title: Former Canadian premier donates 185 acres to protect rare lichens

title: Suryakumar Yadav sends big message with 60 off 21 balls in SMAT

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A remarkable transformation has occurred in Maharashtra, where a collective of 20 women farmers has evolved into the Shiv Swarajya Farmer Producer Company, now boasting 803 members and an annual turnover of Rs 68 lakh. Supported by development organizations, they have enhanced their market access and farming resources. The all-female Board of Directors empowers these women, demonstrating the significant potential of unity in rural agricultural development.
title: Maharashtra women's farm group grows to 803 members, earns Rs 68 lakh

title: Michael Clarke's Sydney mansion heads to auction with $15m price guide

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: MK Stalin has requested Chief Minister Joseph Vijay to hold an all-party meeting about the Mekedatu dam project. He emphasizes the importance of protecting Tamil Nadu's Cauvery water rights. Stalin believes that united political action is necessary to address this critical issue for farmers. Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar asserts Karnataka's right to proceed with the dam construction.
title: Mekedatu Dam row: Stalin seeks united TN stand, asks CM Vijay to call all-party meeting

description: The controversy resurfaced after Khawaja made several claims in his memoir, Sabr, suggesting that the entire Australian team, including current Test captain Cummins, knew about the plan to alter the condition of the ball.
title: 'Are we in kindergarten?': Ex-India player slams Cummins' sandpapergate explanation

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Residents of Poppleton are grappling with the fallout from a protracted legal struggle over local redevelopment initiatives. Following two arduous years in court, the US Supreme Court declined to examine their grievance. Initiated in 2006, the project has failed to deliver on its commitments, contributing to the community's growing unease with empty lots and no grocery options. As the legal challenge concludes, the neighborhood's future hangs in the balance.
title: Baltimore residents lose Supreme Court bid over failed 20-year redevelopment

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi made his captaincy debut for Bihar at just 15 years old. After winning the toss, he humorously forgot his team's playing XI moments later. Although he scored 18 runs, Bihar lost the match to Saurashtra by five wickets. Sooryavanshi has shown remarkable talent since making his India debut just five months ago. He will soon join India A for an upcoming tournament in Doha.
title: ‘Bhool gaya’: Sooryavanshi’s hilarious response at toss on captaincy debut - Watch

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A large fire erupted in a cloth storage godown located in the Kharvasa area of Surat. Fire tenders were immediately dispatched to the scene to combat the flames. Firefighting operations are currently in progress to control the situation. The cause of the fire remains undetermined at this time. Further information regarding the extent of damage is still awaited.
title: Watch: Massive fire at Surat textile godown, thick smoke billows from site

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: JD Vance is considering not running for the 2028 presidential election after Republican losses in the midterms. The ongoing Iran conflict and internal party divisions are major factors in his deliberations. His supporters remain divided on whether he will enter the race despite potential competition emerging within the party. Vance’s relationship with Donald Trump also remains uncertain regarding future support.
title: JD Vance weighs skipping 2028 presidential race after Republican midterm losses: Report

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Telangana BJP president N Ramchander Rao has alleged that party leaders have been placed under house arrest. This action is reportedly taken to prevent their peaceful protests against Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's visit. Rao criticized the Congress government for misusing taxpayers' money and failing to fulfill promises. Meanwhile, Bharat Rashtra Samithi leader KTR questioned Rahul Gandhi's motives during the event.
title: Telangana BJP chief claims house arrest, blames Rahul Gandhi's Hyderabad rally

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: A woman purchased a second-hand iPhone 12 from Arohi Mobile Hub for Rs 29,000, which stopped working soon after. Upon reporting the issue, the shop promised a repair or refund but failed to deliver. The consumer sought to resolve the issue through legal means after repeated unsuccessful attempts. The district consumer disputes redressal commission ruled in her favor and ordered a refund.
title: Himachal woman buys used iPhone for Rs 29,000, gets Rs 59,000 payout ordered

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Magnus Carlsen faces increasing challenges to his world No. 1 title following a series of disappointing results. Fabiano Caruana has narrowed the rating gap significantly after showing exceptional form, including victories in the same tournament where Carlsen unexpectedly lost to Haik Martirosyan. Meanwhile, Arjun Erigaisi overcame Wesley So, and R Vaishali clinched her first win, reshaping the leaderboard landscape in this thrilling tournament.
title: Just 7.2 points apart! Magnus Carlsen risks losing world No. 1 crown after 15 years

title: Watch: Rahul Gandhi rides pillion with gig worker during Hyderabad rally

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: TRAI has barred over 1.24 lakh telecom resources from outgoing services due to unsolicited commercial communication violations. During the July-September quarter, it received 15.29 lakh spam complaints, with 7.23 lakh being actionable. The regulator blacklisted 374 senders and blocked 3,725 SMS headers for one year. A significant number of consumers registered their preferences on the Do Not Disturb registry, totaling 22.449 crore.
title: Spam calls: TRAI bars 1.24 lakh telecom resources, disconnects repeat offenders

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar has stood firm on the Mekedatu Dam project, amidst objections from Tamil Nadu Congress president Manickam Tagore. He emphasized that the project is a right for Karnataka and dismissed the political backlash. To foster dialogue, Shivakumar encouraged Tamil Nadu officials to engage in conversations about the dam's advantages, reaffirming that Karnataka would respect the Supreme Court's ruling on water distribution.
title: 'My state, my right': DKS hits back at TN Cong over Mekedatu Dam row

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: A private London house designed by Zaha Hadid Architects has been listed for £11.95 million. Located in Belgravia, the 3,980-square-foot property is one of only two private residential projects completed by the studio during Hadid's lifetime
title: Rare Zaha Hadid-designed London home listed for £11.95m

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Research highlights that when parents read consistently to their children, it profoundly enriches their vocabulary. Children exposed to five books a day could encounter over 1.4 million words by their fifth birthday, whereas those without such exposure hear only about 4,662 words. Even reading just one book a day can significantly elevate linguistic exposure, underlining the importance of fostering early reading practices.
title: Reading five books daily gives children 1.4m-word head start by age 5: Study

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: According to Dr. Simon Longstaff's analysis, the possibility arises that more players were cognisant of the ball-tampering debacle than initially thought. He highlighted the absence of changes in statements from senior team members during the inquiry. David Warner expressed frustration over Cricket Australia's investigation, highlighting that crucial senior bowlers were not quizzed. Longstaff underscored the importance of further probing into these conflicting statements, questioning the extent of the team's knowledge.
title: ‘More people knew’: Sandpapergate reviewer reveals whispers of wider scandal

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After the devastating loss of his eldest son, Gavin Hynam launched the Cars 4 Youth initiative. This program supplies refurbished cars to disadvantaged young people in regional Victoria and includes mentorship for aspiring drivers. Through these efforts, Hynam has empowered many youths to chase educational and employment aspirations, leading to him being honored as Victoria's Local Hero for 2027.
title: Australian mechanic honours late son by restoring and donating 19 cars

author: MANISHA SINGH
description: Microsoft experienced a significant outage affecting Outlook, Teams, and other services for more than 24 hours. The incident, traced back to a network change, caused disruptions in email communication across various sectors. Companies around the world resorted to using faxes and phone calls as a temporary measure during the outage. Microsoft has confirmed that the issue was not a cyberattack or caused by AI.
title: How one network change disrupted Microsoft Outlook, Teams & AI tools that rely on them

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In France, protests are rapidly gaining momentum as diverse groups unite against new police legislation and economic challenges. Major participants include the influential Yellow Vest movement and various trade unions, with activists also spotlighting child safety and police violence. A controversial police bill, offering enhanced protections for officers, has further fueled these debates, especially with the 2027 presidential election looming, as far-right parties draw increasing scrutiny.
title: 'Licence to kill' row: Child rights and inflation may fuel fresh protests across France

author: SAMAD HOQUE
description: In Gurgaon, a 22-year-old man filmed himself brandishing a gun and posted the video online. He recorded his actions in his father's jewellery shop before police arrived for a visit. The video featured dialogue from known gangster characters and regional music tracks. This social media behavior raised concerns about potential delinquency and prompted monitoring by law enforcement. Authorities are increasingly vigilant about such expressions of violence on social platforms.

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Playing their first match since Messi's retirement from international football in early October, Argentina were unable to begin the new chapter with a win under coach Lionel Scaloni.

description: At just 13, Prince George has displayed his creative flair through a striking drawing of a kingfisher, recently featured in Country Life magazine. description: In a pivotal move, Ukraine is gearing up for a major prisoner exchange with Russia, potentially involving over 1,000 individuals from both nations. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy highlighted the significance of this exchange for families yearning for their loved ones' safe return. Diplomatic initiatives from American envoys are seeking to promote negotiations aimed at ending the ongoing conflict, while discussions also covered humanitarian efforts, particularly regarding the logistics of the exchange.
title: Russia-Ukraine set for biggest-ever prisoner swap amid Trump-led diplomacy

description: A consumer commission mandated a travel booking website and an airline to pay a passenger Rs 1.95 lakh. This decision followed the alteration of his flight itinerary without his consent, resulting in trip cancellation. The commission noted that the companies made changes unilaterally without obtaining approval from the passenger. The travel website and airline were found liable for service deficiencies and unfair practices.

description: India is reportedly seeking Sheikh Hasina’s return to Bangladesh after more than two years in exile, but has set two conditions for Tarique Rahman’s government. According to BBC Bangla, New Delhi wants the Bangladesh army to fly Hasina back and guarantee her an opportunity to appeal her death sentence and face a fresh trial over the July 2024 crackdown.
title: Sheikh Hasina's return to Bangladesh: India wants Dhaka to fulfil two conditions

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft 365 outage update: The company says it has completed efforts to address the underlying issue and restored service for Outlook, Teams and Copilot after a disruption lasting over 24 hours. The outage, which began on November 12, hit users in at least 74 countries, including India. Microsoft traced it to an earlier network capacity upgrade, ruled out a cyberattack and promised a full post-incident report.
title: 'Deeply sorry': Microsoft services return after mega outage; tech giant reveals what happened

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A woman visited a Gurgaon restaurant with friends and was charged an additional service fee. She requested the removal of the Rs 401 service charge, which the restaurant refused to eliminate. After paying the entire bill, she approached the consumer commission regarding the unfair charge. The commission ruled in her favor, ordering a refund and compensation for various expenses.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Driven by the heartfelt loss of a dear friend to a heart attack, Rajat Jain developed Spandan, a revolutionary portable ECG device aimed at improving cardiac care in India's hard-to-reach areas. Since its introduction, over 60,000 units have reached 20,000 villages, screening nearly five million patients and uncovering numerous critical health issues. This project exemplifies how innovative health technology can profoundly impact lives where medical resources are scarce.

description: The Income Tax Department initiated reassessment proceedings against a man after receiving information about transactions associated with a pharma company, described in the information available to the tax authorities as the man’s proprietary concern. The bank account records showed debit entries of Rs 1,27,62,500 and credit entries of Rs 18,85,000.
title: Rs 1.46 crore tax demand on office boy who alleges KYC misuse; what ITAT ruled

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Bharat Electronics Limited has developed an AI-native upgrade for the Integrated Air Command and Control System. This upgrade aims to enhance the air-defence capabilities of the Indian Air Force using advanced technology. The enhanced system will improve the detection and response to threats, including drones and missiles. It will integrate various assets from the Indian military, ensuring a united operational approach.
title: Battle-tested in Op Sindoor, now getting AI upgrade: India's air defence system to get smarter

title: Navy SEAL veteran saves Texas professor, 73, with CPR after classroom collapse

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: BJP has called for the return of 51 cartons of documents belonging to Jawaharlal Nehru. The documents were allegedly taken by Sonia Gandhi in 2008 while the UPA was in power. BJP spokesperson CR Kesavan emphasized the importance of these letters for India's heritage and research. Rahul Gandhi and other Congress leaders paid tribute to Nehru on his birthday, highlighting his contributions to the nation.
title: 'Daro mat': BJP demands return Nehru's letters, including those to Edwina Mountbatten

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: The two-Test series begins in Wellington on November 19. Gurnoor will join the Indian squad in Wellington and, as a result, will miss the fifth and final ODI against New Zealand on Sunday.
title: Gurnoor Brar added to Test squad, Kuldeep released as India go heavier on pace

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Jensen Huang is expected to lose $108 million in unvested stock awards following his exit from Nvidia. His net worth, primarily composed of Nvidia shares, is around $144.5 billion. Huang's holdings include approximately 812 million shares, valued at about $135 billion. Despite this wealth, he has sold around $3 billion in stock since Nvidia's IPO in 1999. Potential legal investigations may impact Huang's ability to sell shares in the future.
title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit costs him Rs 900 crore: How much wealth does he have left?

author: GAURAV GUPTA
description: Kickstarting this Saturday, the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy unfolds at five venues throughout India, shining a spotlight on promising talent. It's a chance for uncapped players to capture the attention of IPL scouts ahead of the auction. Veteran players like Suryakumar Yadav and Mohammed Shami aim to revitalise their journeys, while Prithvi Shaw and Prashant Veer strive to showcase their skills.
title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy offers players a final chance to impress IPL scouts

description: Shiv Sena (UBT) has criticized the ongoing merger discussions involving the NCP, accusing them of being detrimental. The editorial mentions that Sharad Pawar's engagement with the BJP-affiliated group creates confusion in Maharashtra. It also highlights the internal struggles among NCP leaders and their shifting loyalties. Supriya Sule's statement about the merger drama reflects the ongoing conflicts within the party.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Farm Aid, initiated in 1985 by icons like Willie Nelson, Neil Young, and John Mellencamp, has evolved into a cherished annual gathering. The 2026 edition drew a crowd of 14,000, while millions more tuned in via various media. This event not only raised crucial funds but also educated the public about the pressing issues facing family farmers.
title: Willie Nelson's Farm Aid has raised over $90m for farmers in 41 years

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: BJP leader Pradeep Bhandari on Saturday targeted Congress leader Rahul Gandhi over his year-old remarks on Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chhath Puja, demanding a public apology for allegedly calling the festival "drama". Bhandari questioned the Congress's respect for Hindu sentiments. The attack came amid Chhath celebrations and a day after MNS chief Raj Thackeray accused the BJP of "divide and rule" over the festival.
title: 'Chhath Puja not drama': BJP accuses Rahul of disrespecting Hindu festivals

author: TNN
description: A father named Kaushal Patel allegedly strangled his daughter Saniya after confronting her about her relationship. Following the murder, he attempted to cover it up by claiming she died by suicide. Medical professionals found signs of foul play and initiated a forensic examination of Saniya's body. Subsequently, Kaushal confessed to the crime during police questioning and was arrested. The incident highlights ongoing issues related to inter-caste relationships in the region.
title: 'She took it as a joke': Gujarat man strangles daughter over inter-caste relationship

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Loew’s Jersey Theatre has joyfully reopened its doors after a thorough restoration process that spanned several years. Kicking off its first major event, the esteemed venue will host the Trey Anastasio Band on November 13. The excitement doesn't stop there—on December 2, a community concert will take place, followed by electrifying performances from The War on Drugs and Jodeci later in the month.
title: New Jersey theatre saved from demolition reopens after $130m restoration

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Elon Musk has signed an open letter urging Nvidia’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, joining more than 43,000 signers, including current and former Nvidia employees, shareholders and tech leaders like Tim Sweeney and Garry Tan. The letter demands an independent investigation, a fair hearing and a public explanation, days after Huang resigned over reported extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, ending his 33-year run.
title: Elon Musk joins over 43,000 people asking Nvidia’s board to bring back Jensen Huang

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Equatorial Guinea goalkeeper Jesus Owono has received a 12-match suspension due to a serious incident on the field. The collision with Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel led to de Miguel's tragic death shortly after the match. FC Andorra manager Carles Manso emphasised the importance of supporting Owono during this difficult time. De Miguel's family expressed gratitude for the public support and crowdfunding efforts raised for them.
title: Maximum sanction! Jesus Owono handed 12-match ban after Jesus de Miguel's death

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has come under fire for misleading his top executives about an affair with Alice Huang. He characterized their ties as ordinary business dealings, not an intimate relationship. As accusations of Alice spying for China surfaced, Nvidia's board has initiated an investigation. After a significant decline in stock values, Huang resigned and publicly acknowledged his unfaithfulness to his wife.
title: Nvidia spy scandal: What Jensen Huang told top officials about relationship with Alice

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: On November 13, a significant communications failure caused a nationwide ground stop for US flights. Airports experienced delays, cancellations, and diversions, affecting approximately 1.5 million passengers. The Federal Aviation Administration identified outdated equipment as the primary cause for the disruption and enforced departure restrictions for safety. Following the incident, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy requested $50 billion in emergency funding for infrastructure modernization.
title: America's air traffic control meltdown: How US flight crisis unfolded & what next

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: US flight disruptions: Nationwide ground stop ordered for only the second time since 9/11

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Lakshya Sen secured a place in the men's singles final at the Kumamoto Masters in Japan. He defeated Alwi Farhan in a semifinal match, winning with scores of 21-12, 15-21, and 21-11. This victory adds to his recent success after winning the Hylo Open in Germany. Kidambi Srikanth, however, faced elimination in the quarterfinals against Koki Watanabe. Lakshya's performance improves his chances for qualification for the upcoming World Tour Finals.
title: Lakshya Sen storms into second straight final, keeps World Tour Finals hopes alive

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
title: Who is Rene Haas? The Arm CEO in race to succeed Jensen Huang at Nvidia

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Meghna Khanna, an entrepreneur, closed her handcrafted jewelry business, Levitate, due to the Covid-19 pandemic. After a conversation about bindis, she launched The Bindi Project in December 2022. The brand creates handcrafted, reusable bindis, and achieved annual revenues of Rs 20 lakh by FY25. Bollywood stylists have recognized the brand, increasing its visibility through celebrity endorsements.
title: After Covid closed jewellery biz, Bengaluru woman builds Rs 20-lakh bindi brand

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft has denied any link between its global Microsoft 365 outage and the FAA ground stop that halted every departing US flight, leaving 10,000+ flights delayed and 6,600 cancelled. "We have no indication that the FAA's nationwide ground stop is related to any Microsoft services," the company said. US officials blamed overloaded routers on an ageing air traffic control network, ruling out a cyberattack and the FAA's SMART AI tool.
title: Microsoft has a message on the FAA ground stop that delayed 10,000+ flights in the US

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: In another development in the controversy that rocked Australian cricket, Warner claimed that CA did not interview Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Starc or Nathan Lyon during its investigation in the days after the Cape Town Test in 2018.
title: 'CA didn't interview Hazlewood, Starc, Lyon': Warner’s explosive claim in sandpaper twist

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: 'Jewel of India': PM Modi, Rahul Gandhi, Rajnath pay tribute to Nehru

author: TNN
description: A 13-year-old girl allegedly orchestrated her grandfather's murder with three male friends to obtain money. The plan reportedly unfolded over two months via social media communication. The three boys executed the murder by entering the victim's house and physically assaulting him. Following the crime, they allegedly stole gold and disposed of the evidence. Authorities are determining whether the boys will be tried as adults based on the case's severity.
title: ‘Planned for 2 months on Insta’: How girl, 3 friends killed grandpa over money for iPhone

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The FAA has lifted the nationwide ground stop caused by a communications failure affecting air traffic control. Passengers should expect ongoing delays and cancellations as airlines reschedule flights and crews recover. The communications disruption led to a halt of more than 3,500 flights during the afternoon. Despite the resolution, airlines warn disruptions may continue into the weekend.
title: US flight chaos: Ground stop ends, but will your flight take off? Trump aide explains

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An 87-year-old disabled California wildfire survivor is struggling to rebuild his life after losing his Altadena home in the 2025 Eaton Fire. Peter Brown claims his contractor went $90,000 over budget and is demanding another $51,000 to finish the house. With his insurance money and savings exhausted, he remains homeless and pays $2,500 monthly rent.
title: 87-year-old Eaton Fire survivor says contractor left him homeless, broke

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Shakeel, who had scored 93 in Pakistan's first innings total of 434/9 declared, fell just three runs short of his century in the second innings. The left-hander spent most of the fifth and final day at the crease before Lahiru Kumara bowled him after he had faced 210 deliveries.
title: Just 6th overall and 1st in Pak's history: Saud joins rare Test batting record list

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Megna Jain began her entrepreneurial adventure at the tender age of 18, introducing her cupcake business during college in Bengaluru. With a startup investment of Rs 5,000, she navigated early struggles and eventually created Dream A Dozen. The pandemic inspired a creative shift towards corporate gifting, propelling her sales and expanding her client base to over 500.
title: Bengaluru woman turns Rs 5,000 cupcakes into Rs 1 crore bakery

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In India, Children's Day is celebrated on November 14, paying homage to Chacha Nehru's birthday and dedication to children's welfare. Schools typically host activities leading up to this special day, focusing on the joys of childhood and the timeless wisdom from older generations. The occasion serves to uplift and inspire children, emphasizing the pivotal role of nurturing young minds for a brighter future.
title: 75+ happy children's day messages, greetings, wishes and quotes

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: US flight chaos: What caused FAA outage that grounded departures nationwide

author: MAHIMA SHARMA
description: Next week, US President Donald Trump will engage with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit, despite claims regarding businesswoman Alice Huang and her connection to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang surfacing in the media. Sources reveal that Trump won't cover these allegations during his talks with Xi. Nvidia is conducting a separate inquiry into Alice Huang's supposed espionage, which Beijing firmly denies amid the ongoing investigation.
title: Nvidia probe, China spy claims: Trump unlikely to confront Xi over Alice Huang

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The father of 20-year-old co-pilot Nathalia Filgueiras, who was killed along with eight others in a Learjet crash on a Florida highway, has spoken about the pain of hearing the aircraft’s final radio transmissions. Calling his daughter a hero, Allan Filgueiras is seeking answers about the crash, questioning why the aircraft continued through bad weather instead of diverting.
title: Father calls co-pilot daughter killed in Florida crash a ‘hero’

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: The opening Test was repeatedly interrupted by bad light, forcing players to leave the field before the scheduled close of play on most days.
title: 141 overs lost: Babar suggests 'pink' solution for Pakistan's winter Test problem

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Travelers on Air India flights faced significant delays due to a nationwide communication failure that affected the FAA, leading to a temporary ground halt of all flight departures across the U.S. Although the ground stop has since been lifted, passengers should brace for ongoing disruptions as the situation unfolds. Investigations are in progress to pinpoint the cause behind this communication breakdown, with safety being the top priority for FAA officials.
title: US flight disruption: Air India flags possible delays to US-bound services

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: After spending eight years in Greece, Hargurjit Singh Minhas has returned to Punjab with a vision to revolutionize farming. He cultivated 60 acres with a focus on sugarcane, integrating innovative planting techniques and intercropping. This enhanced productivity allows him to provide harvesting services to neighboring farmers, effectively boosting his income and transforming his family's land into a thriving agricultural business.
title: Returned from Greece, Punjab man builds Rs 2 crore sugarcane business

author: HINDOL BASU
description: Matt Finishes India Off With Devastating 6/27, Including Wickets Of Rohit, Kohli & Iyer In Opening Over, As India Sink To Second-Biggest Defeat In ODIs; Will Young Sizzles With Ton In 244-Run Win For Kiwis
title: Matt Henry's three-ball demolition exposes India's batting frailties ahead of WC

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A decade-long restoration project in west Norfolk has brilliantly converted agricultural land into a vibrant natural habitat. Spearheaded by Olly Birkbeck in collaboration with Natural England, this initiative has attracted a wealth of wildlife. By replanting local flora with meticulously sourced native seeds and employing conservation grazing techniques, the project effectively manages habitats, keeping invasive species at bay while promoting overall biodiversity and encouraging ecological connectivity in the region.
title: Farmer turns 1,200 acres into wildlife haven, rare species return

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: Trump, Xi and Putin set for unprecedented trilateral meeting in China

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: In a challenging fourth ODI against New Zealand, Virat Kohli's recent dismissal led to his rise to 42 international ducks, placing him only one behind Zaheer Khan's 43. He also shares the dubious honor of having 20 ducks in ODIs with Sachin Tendulkar. India's batting collapse resulted in a heavy 244-run loss, making the upcoming final ODI essential for a turnaround.
title: One away from Zaheer! Kohli climbs to 2nd on unwanted list after NZ horror show

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: US nationwide flight disruption: Trump rules out cyberattack, role of AI

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: A nationwide ground stop for flights in the United States was ordered due to a telecommunications outage. The Federal Aviation Administration implemented the measure to ensure safety as communications were disrupted. Thousands of passengers faced delays and cancellations across various airports. Investigations are ongoing to determine the cause of the telecommunications failure, but no security threat has been identified.
title: US flight chaos: Thousands stranded as FAA halts take-offs nationwide – what we know so far

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: James Dorsey, a 95-year-old resident of Houston, has finally secured his long-missing birth certificate, a significant milestone that eluded him for decades. Born on a Louisiana plantation, Dorsey discovered the absence of this key document while planning his marriage. With the assistance of attorney Raynique Keelen, necessary corrections were made to his birth record, affirming his status as a recognized American citizen.
title: At 95, Houston great-grandfather finally gets birth certificate

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A recent study has uncovered that the gravestone of Rob Roy MacGregor, found at Balquhidder Parish Church, has roots that stretch back an astonishing thousand years prior to his life. Utilizing 3D imaging techniques, researchers have discovered that the stone features carvings from multiple eras, hinting at a potential connection to early medieval Christianity through its intricate designs. For those intrigued, digital models have been made publicly accessible for exploration.
title: Scans suggest Rob Roy's gravestone has carvings 1,000 years older than him

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In 2018, Kapil Kumar launched the Clean Up Ram Ganga Campaign to tackle the escalating pollution crisis of the river. Over 5,000 volunteers have joined forces for more than 218 clean-up drives, focusing not just on removing trash but also fostering responsible waste management practices. With efforts aimed at composting organic waste and addressing untreated sewage, Kumar advocates for a lasting change in community behavior towards the river's health.
title: Moradabad volunteers remove 1.2 lakh kg waste from Ramganga river since 2018

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Convicted of a fraudulent cattle investment scheme, Joshua and Jason Link swindled over 2,200 investors, misleading them into thinking their money was turning into cattle purchases. Their actions resulted in colossal financial damages, as they raised more than $240 million through non-existent contracts. Investigations uncovered that funds were misused for personal luxuries rather than fulfilling their financial promises to investors.
title: Texas brothers convicted in $240m cattle scheme that defrauded 2,200 people

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: SpaceX's ambitious Starship double-catch attempt fails as booster ends up in Gulf
